data.name: FwAvalonia.EntryTypeUnsupported
data.value: This entry type is not yet supported in the new view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.UnsupportedEditor
data.value: This field is not yet supported in the new view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.EmbeddedObjectReadOnly
data.value: This text contains formatting the new view cannot edit safely yet.
data.comment: Tooltip on a text row the managed editor holds read-only because a plain-text edit would corrupt it: the value carries an embedded object (ORC) the runs cannot rebuild, or a run carries a TsString property the model does not round-trip (e.g. colour, offset, superscript). The lossless original is preserved for display and stays fully editable in the classic view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.UndoChangeToFormat
data.comment: "Undo change to {0}" -- field-specific undo label for the fenced lexical-edit session when a single field's edit opened it ({0} = the field label). Falls back to <see cref="UndoEditEntry"/> for the batch/bulk path where no single field applies.

data.name: FwAvalonia.RedoChangeToFormat
data.comment: "Redo change to {0}" -- the redo counterpart of <see cref="UndoChangeToFormat"/>.

data.name: FwAvalonia.PossibilityNameOrAbbreviationRequired
data.value: A name or abbreviation is required.
data.comment: Validation message when a list item (CmPossibility) has neither a Name nor an Abbreviation.

data.name: FwAvalonia.EditDiscardedInvalid
data.value: Your edit was discarded because it is invalid: {0}
data.comment: Warning shown when a pending lexical edit is rolled back on navigate/close because it fails validation (the edit is not silently lost -- the user is told why). {0} is the validation reason(s).

data.name: FwAvalonia.EditDiscardedInvalidTitle
data.comment: Title of the EditDiscardedInvalid warning.

data.name: FwAvalonia.AudioRecordingReadOnly
data.value: Audio recording (read-only in the new view)
data.comment: Placeholder shown in a read-only text row for a voice/audio (IsVoice) writing system: the new view cannot yet play or record audio, so the row stays read-only and visible rather than a blank editable box that would corrupt the recording on edit. Editing stays available in the classic view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Remove
data.comment: "Remove" -- reference-vector item context command.

data.name: FwAvalonia.AddItem
data.comment: "Add item" -- reference-vector add-slot launcher name.

data.name: FwAvalonia.SearchPrompt
data.comment: "Type to search" -- the search-backed add slot's type-ahead watermark.

data.name: FwAvalonia.AddSelected
data.comment: "Add" -- confirm button of the multi-select reference-vector add picker; commits the checked set in one undoable step.

data.name: FwAvalonia.CreateOptionPrompt
data.comment: Create row of a picker that can mint a new item from typed text ({0} = the text). Only shown by rows whose edit context supports creation.

data.name: FwAvalonia.LaunchDialog
data.comment: Accessible name of the "..." dialog-launcher button.

data.name: FwAvalonia.LauncherUnavailable
data.value: This dialog is not available here.
data.comment: Tooltip of a disabled launcher button: no host dialog service.

data.name: FwAvalonia.FieldSettings
data.comment: "{0} settings" -- accessible name of a chooser's hover-revealed settings gear.

data.name: FwAvalonia.EditListFormat
data.comment: "Edit the {0} list" -- label/tooltip of a configure-gear jump derived from the row's possibility list (the legacy chooser dialog's "Edit the ... list" link text).

data.name: FwAvalonia.LexemeFormLabel
data.comment: "Lexeme Form" -- first-slice row label (compiled override and authored fallback).

data.name: FwAvalonia.MorphTypeLabel
data.comment: "Morph Type" -- first-slice row label (authored fallback).

data.name: FwAvalonia.GlossLabel
data.comment: "Gloss" -- first-slice row label (authored fallback).

data.name: FwAvalonia.FieldOptionsMenu
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the hover-revealed "..." field-options button on each field row (opens the Field Visibility / Move Field / Help menu -- the affordance that replaced right-click).

data.name: FwAvalonia.CharacterStyle
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the character-style picker affordance on an editable text row that opens the list of the project's character styles to apply to the current selection.

data.name: FwAvalonia.DefaultCharacterStyle
data.comment: The "Default/None" entry that leads the character-style picker; selecting it CLEARS any named character style on the current selection, reverting it to the paragraph's default.

data.name: FwAvalonia.WritingSystem
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the writing-system picker affordance on an editable text row that opens the list of the project's writing systems to retag the current selection.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.NotSure
data.comment: "<Not sure>" -- the default empty / unspecified Part-of-Speech entry (legacy PopupTreeManager "<Not sure>").

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.Any
data.comment: "<Any>" -- the unspecified Part-of-Speech entry when the host treats unspecified as "any" (legacy MSAGroupBox NotSureIsAny).

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.CreateNew
data.value: Create a new Part of Speech...
data.comment: "Create a new Part of Speech..." -- the inline create affordance at the bottom of the POS tree (legacy "More..." item that launched MasterCategoryListDlg).

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.ChooserName
data.comment: Accessible name of the collapsed Part-of-Speech chooser dropdown.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.AddParagraph
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the per-paragraph "add paragraph" affordance in a structured-text field.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.DeleteParagraph
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the per-paragraph "delete paragraph" affordance in a structured-text field.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.ParagraphStyle
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the per-paragraph style picker in a structured-text field: opens the list of the project's paragraph styles to apply to this paragraph.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.DefaultParagraphStyle
data.comment: The "Default" entry that leads the paragraph-style picker; selecting it CLEARS any named paragraph style on the paragraph, reverting it to the default.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Link
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the external-link affordance on an editable text row that opens a small URL prompt that inserts a hyperlink over the selection, or edits an existing link's URL.

data.name: FwAvalonia.LinkUrlPrompt
data.comment: Watermark / accessible name of the URL entry in the link prompt flyout.

data.name: FwAvalonia.LinkApply
data.comment: The confirm button of the link prompt flyout: insert / update the hyperlink.

data.name: FwAvalonia.DeleteEmbeddedObject
data.comment: Accessible name / tooltip of the delete-embedded-object affordance that removes the embedded object (link, picture, footnote, ...) under the selection. Any ORC kind is deletable here even when its insert/edit path lives elsewhere.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.Play
data.comment: Play affordance for an existing audio recording on a voice-WS row (legacy ShortSoundFieldControl play).

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.Record
data.comment: Record affordance for a voice-WS row (legacy ShortSoundFieldControl record).

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.Clear
data.comment: Clear-the-recording affordance for a voice-WS row (legacy ShortSoundFieldControl delete).

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.RecordUnavailable
data.value: Recording is available on Windows in the new view; use the classic view on this platform.
data.comment: Tooltip on the record affordance when recording is unavailable on this platform.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.NoRecording
data.comment: Placeholder shown for a voice-WS row that has no recording yet.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StructuredText.ParagraphName
data.comment: Screen-reader name for one paragraph editor in a multi-paragraph StText field. {0} = the field label, {1} = the 1-based paragraph number.

data.name: FwAvalonia.FeatureGroup.LexicalEntryDialogs
data.comment: Group heading for the entry-editing tools in the catalog.

data.name: FwAvalonia.FeatureGroup.OtherRecordTypes
data.comment: Group heading for the non-entry record-type tools in the catalog.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Feature.LexiconEditPopupDescription
data.value: The popup variant of entry editing.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Chooser.EmptyItemLabel
data.comment: The empty-choice label a list chooser leads with when the field allows no value. English must match the legacy launchers' <c>ksNullLabel</c> so both frameworks show the same word.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Reversal.ShowInReversalIndex
data.comment: The row menu command that jumps to the row's entry in the Reversal Index tool.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Reversal.AddEntryName
data.comment: Screen-reader name for a writing system's empty add row. {0} = the field label, {1} = the writing system abbreviation.
